# Third-party libraries (vendored, minified builds from npm)

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | gsap | 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `lenis.min.js`, `lenis.css` | lenis | 1.3.27 | MIT |
| `matter.min.js` | matter-js | 0.20.0 | MIT |

Update: `npm pack <package>` and copy the same files from `dist/` (gsap, lenis) or `build/` (matter-js).

Display font: Clash Display by Indian Type Foundry, loaded from the Fontshare API (ITF Free Font License 2.0, commercial use allowed). It is not stored in this public repository because the licence forbids redistributing the font files.
